purpose: Trigger routing for tool-design-checker: MCP server authors grading their tools, and users sizing the tool load of the MCP servers configured in their harnesses. Near misses cover building a server and the sibling skills for sandboxes, session cost, instruction files, guardrails, and loops.

cases.prompt: lint my MCP server's tool descriptions
cases.assert: Runs tools_check.py lint on the server (asking before launching it) and reports grades and fixes.

cases.prompt: how many tools and tokens do my MCP servers load into the context window
cases.assert: Runs tools_check.py installed, then asks before --launch, and leads with the per-harness tool and token totals.

cases.prompt: grade the tools in my MCP server before I publish it
cases.assert: Grades each tool A to F with the stated rubric and lists the five weakest tools with exact fixes.

cases.prompt: which MCP servers do I have installed across Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
cases.assert: Runs installed without --launch and shows each server, where it is configured, and the command it runs, with no env values.

cases.prompt: my MCP tools overlap across servers and the model picks the wrong one
cases.assert: Launches the configured servers only after a yes, then reports the tool pairs that collide across servers.

cases.prompt: review these OpenAI function definitions for unclear parameter descriptions
cases.assert: Runs lint --tools on the saved function list and reports param-no-description and unclear-purpose findings.

cases.prompt: does my MCP server need readOnlyHint annotations on its tools
cases.assert: Lints the tools and explains the readonly-hint-missing and destructive-hint findings with the MCP defaults.

cases.prompt: check the input schemas of my MCP tools
cases.assert: Reports schema findings such as required fields missing from properties, deep nesting, and large enums.

cases.prompt: build a new MCP server in Python for my Postgres database
cases.assert: Building a server is not grading one; no skill in this set fits.

cases.prompt: what secret files and folders can my coding agent read
why did my Claude Code sessions cost so much this month
check which instruction files Codex loads from AGENTS.md
do my permission rules and hooks block git push --force
stop my agent when it keeps calling the same command in a loop
